stories.headline: Federal Constitutional Court says doctors cannot run drug stores without a licence
stories.summary: The Federal Constitutional Court held that the Pharmacy Act and Drugs Act perform different legal functions and set aside a 2023 Peshawar High Court order that had restrained regulatory action.
stories.why_it_matters: The ruling clarifies the legal distinction between medical practice and licensing requirements for drug retail.

sources.title: Doctors cannot run drug stores without licence: FCC

stories.headline: Pakistan's July-September exports rise 11% while trade deficit widens 15.13%
stories.summary: Pakistan's exports increased 11% while the trade deficit widened 15.13% to $10.79 billion during July-September, according to figures reported on October 3.
stories.why_it_matters: The figures show that export growth did not prevent external trade imbalance from widening.

stories.headline: Houthis claim missile and drone attack on Aramco facility in Riyadh
stories.summary: Yemen's Iran-aligned Houthis said they targeted an Aramco facility in Riyadh with missiles and drones amid escalating regional hostilities.
stories.why_it_matters: Attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure have implications for Gulf security and global energy markets.

sources.title: Yemen's Houthis say they attacked Aramco facility in Riyadh with missiles, drones
